why:
I checked verifier Check 4 against both must_not items, and it avoids both.

Item 1 (fetching the live page): Check 4 says "do not fetch or read https://o.github.io/greet-cli/". It judges what the head commit contains instead: pages.yml must still publish docs/ ("upload-pages-artifact step with `path: docs` and a deploy-pages step") on push to the default branch. The builder brief also says "Do not try to deploy or publish anything yourself."

Item 2 (a silent PASS with no evidence): the PASS needs concrete evidence from the head commit: the workflow and docs/index.md listing --shout. It also says "Say in your report that the live published page can only be seen after merge." That rules out a silent pass. The FAIL conditions are spelled out too.

Checks 1–3 and the advisory notes break neither item.
